SearchAlertContactGroup.description_en: Queries alert contact groups by calling the SearchAlertContactGroup operation
SearchAlertContactGroup.description_zh: 调用SearchAlertContactGroup接口查询报警联系人分组

SearchAlertHistories.description_en: Queries the alert history of alert rules by calling the SearchAlertHistories operation
SearchAlertHistories.description_zh: 调用SearchAlertHistories接口查询报警规则的报警发送记录

SearchAlertRules.description_en: Queries alert rules by calling the SearchAlertRules operation
SearchAlertRules.description_zh: 调用SearchAlertRules接口查询报警规则

SearchEvents.description_en: Queries alert event records by calling the SearchEvents operation
SearchEvents.description_zh: 调用SearchEvents接口查询报警事件记录

SearchRetcodeAppByPage.description_en: Queries Browser Monitoring nodes by using paged queries
SearchRetcodeAppByPage.description_zh: 分页查询前端监控任务

SearchTraceAppByName.description_en: Queries Application Monitoring jobs by application name
SearchTraceAppByName.description_zh: 按应用名称查询应用监控任务

SearchTraceAppByPage.description_en: Queries Application Monitoring monitoring jobs by paging
SearchTraceAppByPage.description_zh: 分页查询应用监控任务

SearchTraces.description_en: Queries the list of traces. You can filter traces by time, application name, IP address, span name, and tags
SearchTraces.description_zh: 查询调用链列表信息，可根据时间、应用名称、IP地址、Span名称和Tag等信息筛选调用链

SearchTracesByPage.description_en: Queries trace list information by paging. You can filter traces by time, application name, IP address, span name, and tags
SearchTracesByPage.description_zh: 分页查询调用链列表信息，可根据时间、应用名称、IP地址、Span名称和Tag等信息筛选调用链

SendTTSVerifyLink.description_en: Sends a phone number verification SMS to an alert contact
SendTTSVerifyLink.description_zh: 为告警联系人发送手机号码验证短信

SetRetcodeShareStatus.description_en: Enables or disables the logon-free sharing feature for a Browser Monitoring site. After this feature is enabled, you can access the Browser Monitoring page by using the URL obtained by calling the GetRetcodeShareUrl operation
SetRetcodeShareStatus.description_zh: 打开或关闭前端监控站点的免登录分享开关，打开该功能后即可通过调用GetRetcodeShareUrl接口获取的地址访问前端监控页面

StartAlert.description_en: Starts an alert rule by calling the StartAlert operation
StartAlert.description_zh: 调用StartAlert接口启动报警规则

StartTimingSyntheticTask.description_en: Starts a scheduled Synthetic Monitoring task

StopAlert.description_zh: 调用StartAlert接口停止报警规则

SwitchSyntheticTaskStatus.description_en: Starts or stops a scheduled Synthetic Monitoring task
SwitchSyntheticTaskStatus.description_zh: 启动或者停止定时拨测任务

SyncRecordingRules.description_en: Synchronizes the aggregation rules of a cluster to other target clusters across the region in batches
SyncRecordingRules.description_zh: 将某个集群的聚合规则批量同步到全Region的其他目标集群

TagResources.description_en: Adds tags to Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) resource instances
TagResources.description_zh: 用于给ARMS资源实例打标签

UninstallManagedPrometheus.description_en: Uninstalls managed Prometheus from ASK, ECS, or ACK One clusters

UninstallPromCluster.description_en: Uninstalls an ARMS Prometheus cluster instance

UntagResources.description_en: Deletes instance labels from Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) resource instances
UntagResources.description_zh: 用于删除ARMS资源实例标签

UpdateAlertContact.description_en: Updates an alert contact by calling the UpdateAlertContact operation
UpdateAlertContact.description_zh: 调用UpdateAlertContact接口更新报警联系人

UpdateAlertContactGroup.description_en: Updates an alert contact group by calling the UpdateAlertContactGroup operation
UpdateAlertContactGroup.description_zh: 调用UpdateAlertContactGroup接口更新报警联系人分组

UpdateAlertRule.description_en: Updates an alert rule by calling the UpdateAlertRule operation
UpdateAlertRule.description_zh: 调用UpdateAlertRule接口更新报警规则

UpdateDispatchRule.description_en: Modifies a dispatch policy by calling the UpdateDispatchRule operation
UpdateDispatchRule.description_zh: 调用UpdateDispatchRule接口修改分派策略

UpdateEnvCustomJob.description_en: Updates a custom job for an environment

UpdateEnvDropMetricsRule.description_en: Updates the drop metric rules in an environment
UpdateEnvDropMetricsRule.description_zh: 更新环境中废弃指标规则

UpdateEnvPodMonitor.description_en: Updates a PodMonitor in an environment

UpdateEnvServiceMonitor.description_en: Updates the ServiceMonitor of an environment

UpdateGrafanaWorkspace.description_en: Updates the information of a specified Grafana workspace

UpdateGrafanaWorkspaceAccountRole.description_en: Modifies the role of an account in a specified workspace
UpdateGrafanaWorkspaceAccountRole.description_zh: 修改指定工作区下账号的角色

UpdateGrafanaWorkspaceVersion.description_en: Updates the version of a Grafana workspace

UpdateMetricDrop.description_en: Updates the list of deprecated metrics

UpdatePrometheusGlobalView.description_en: Updates a Prometheus for GlobalView aggregation data source
UpdatePrometheusGlobalView.description_zh: 更新Prometheus for GlobalView聚合数据源

UpdatePrometheusIntegration.description_en: Modifies the Integration Center Exporter configuration of a Prometheus instance. Only aliyun-cs and ecs instance types are supported
UpdatePrometheusIntegration.description_zh: 更改Prometheus实例（仅支持aliyun-cs、ecs两种类型的实例）集成中心Exporter配置

UpdatePrometheusMonitoring.description_en: Updates the monitoring configuration of a Prometheus instance

UpdatePrometheusMonitoringStatus.description_en: Updates the instance monitoring configuration status of a Prometheus instance
UpdatePrometheusMonitoringStatus.description_zh: 更新Prometheus实例监控配置状态

UpdateRumApp.description_en: Updates a Real User Monitoring (RUM) application

UpdateRumFileStatus.description_en: Updates the status of a Real User Monitoring (RUM) file. Call this operation after a RUM file is uploaded
UpdateRumFileStatus.description_zh: 更新RUM文件状态，上传RUM文件成功后，调用此接口

UpdateTimingSyntheticTask.description_en: Updates a scheduled Synthetic Monitoring task

UpdateWebhook.description_en: Calls the UpdateWebhook operation to modify Webhook alert contact information
UpdateWebhook.description_zh: 调用UpdateWebhook接口修改Webhook告警联系人信息

Upload.description_en: Uploads a SourceMap file to Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) Browser Monitoring
